title: The Supply
subtitle: The same gate on a measured task
description: Every other task in this chapter is a checkmark, so its condition is met at
a press. This one is an item task: the server counts eight cobblestone in
the inventory on the task's own schedule, and the condition beside it says
the count only means anything while the player carries the stage
Both halves are false until both are true. With the stone in hand and no
stage, the count is not taken at all -- the quest sits at zero, and the
moment the stage arrives the same stone is counted, with nothing to press.
That is what a condition does to a measured task: it gates the reading,
